\scheading{2}{A nine-hundred-word paragraph}{a11}{A nine-hundred-word paragraph}{1}{0}

The extraction phase resolves each candidate against the Legacy Survey DR11 sweep catalogues before any spectroscopic cross-match is attempted, because a photometric non-detection changes what a missing spectrum means. A cell that has already been fetched is never re-requested: the ledger records success and failure independently of the rows themselves, so a crash part-way through a wide declination band costs only the cells still in flight when it happened, and a retry pass touches nothing that already succeeded.
